rapport_notes: Warm and attentive, addressed the customer's specific worry thoughtfully and closed on a personal, appreciative note.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "I do ask this for all our clients. Is there any specific concern or what are you most worried about for this upcoming move?" — asked after date, addresses, and inventory were already covered
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised a real concern (items getting lost/left behind at the storage unit) and Amy gave a solid direct reassurance (dedicated truck, point-to-point) but didn't ask a follow-up question to dig further
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "If we go beyond the minimum... we prorate every fifteen minute increments" covers the window/fairness substance, though not the full scripted line set

top_strength: Asked the agenda question and got a real, specific concern (losing items in transit), then gave a direct, reassuring answer tied to the company's one-client-at-a-time policy.
coaching_note: The agenda question landed after several logistics questions instead of right at the top of the call — moving it earlier, and following the customer's concern with one more digging question ('anything else you're worried about?'), would lock in full credit on both Stage 1 items.
